rationale: Shelf life cut to 120 days with 60% required at receipt: goods made 2026-09-10 must arrive by 2026-10-28. The ocean arrival (2026-11-09) is out; the first sea-air sailing (arrives about 2026-10-24) is in. So the cost-optimal plan becomes sea-air at about 21,400 USD.
falsifier: Refuted if the cost-optimal plan is not sea-air only, or if its cost falls outside 20,000-23,000 USD.
